answer: Birth, not registration, gives weight: ripple records one lineage in which a parent may spawn only after its last child is judged; each birth locks one walnut and burns nectar equal to the child’s order in that line. Honest start: one judged epoch, 1 walnut, 1 nectar. One operator’s kth clone waits behind k−1 births, locks another walnut and burns k nectar, so n heads need n serial epochs, n walnut and n(n+1)/2 nectar; an unborn key has no ripple.
